newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Panamerican Beverages starts.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Panamerican Beverages starts.

text.p: -- SBC Warburg analyst Tim Baker said on Friday he had started coverage of Mexico's Panamerican Beverages Inc, or Panamco, with a rating of buy.
-- In an analysis, he set a target price for the company's American Depositary Receipt of $66. Baker estimated earnings per share of $2.35 in 1996, $2.78 in 1997 and $3.47 in 1998.
-- "Panamco is positioned in one of the most dynamic beverage markets in the world," he wrote of the Latin American bottler of Coca-Cola Co.

-- "It is expected to continue to achieve double-digit EBITDA growth for the foreseeable future, driven by market growth, increasing market shares (particularly flavors), operational efficiencies and further acquisitions.
-- "Our peer group analysis suggests it is currently 11 percent undervalued, while we see at least 30 percent upside for the stock in the medium term."
-- The company's shares closed at 49-1/4 in New York on Thursday.
